# Masscan

`masscan` &middot; _information-gathering_

An extremely fast port scanner for wide address ranges you are authorised to test.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A target range you are authorised to scan.
- Raw-socket access (see docs/LIMITATIONS.md).
- Keep the rate low on a shared network; it can saturate a link.

## How to use it

Masscan is like nmap but tuned for speed across large ranges. Use a low `--rate` on a home or office network (e.g. 500 packets/second) so you do not disrupt it. Confirm the range is in scope before running.

## Examples

```console
$ masscan 192.168.1.0/24 -p1-1000 --rate 500
$ masscan 10.0.0.0/8 -p80,443 --rate 2000
```
